S00A_0000_0100#0: Half asleep, I woke to the dazzling light.
S00A_0000_0100#1: I raised my head and looked around.
S00A_0000_0100#2: \nA few students were opening the lecture hall curtains.
S00A_0000_0300#0: A lecture on drugs, on a beautiful day like this. So much for a healthy lifestyle.
S00A_0000_0300#1: \nThe professor speaking evenly at the lectern specializes in pharmacology.
S00A_0000_0300#2: \nHe also holds a medical doctorate. Once a week, he lectures on how drugs affect society.
S00A_0000_0310_CALL01#0: I signed up for this class because...
S00A_0000_SEL_00A_0000_01#0: I keep hearing rumors about drugs.
S00A_0000_SEL_00A_0000_02#0: There is a girl I like.
S00A_0000_0310_CALL02#0: I keep hearing rumors about drugs.
S00A_0000_0310_CALL02#1: \nI do not know the details, but something strange is apparently making the rounds.
S00A_0000_0400#0: Not that I am interested in the drugs themselves.
S00A_0000_0400#2: \nSo why do some people try them anyway?
S00A_0000_0410#0: I wanted to understand the minds of people who fall into drug use.
S00A_0000_0410#1: \nBut the lecture went on and on about their dangers, and my mind kept drifting toward sleep.
S00A_0005_0100#0: His slow, measured voice had the rhythm of a hypnotist lulling me to sleep.
S00A_0005_0100#1: I could not help letting out a huge yawn.
S00A_0005_0100#2: That was the last thing I remembered.
S00A_0005_0100#3: \nI buried my head in my backpack and used it as a pillow.
